module autovcoder_002937 (
    clk,
    rst,
    ctrl,
    z,
    dout
);
  input clk;
  input rst;
  input [3:0] ctrl;
  input signed [15:0] z;
  output signed [15:0] dout;

  //wires and regs
  reg [15:0] a1;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst == 1'b1) begin
      a1 <= 16'd0;
    end else begin
      if (ctrl == 4'b0101) begin
        if (z[15] == 1'b1) begin
          if ((-z) > 16'b000101_0000000000) begin
            a1 <= 16'd0;
          end else if (((-z) > 16'b000010_0110000000) && ((-z) < 16'b000101_0000000000))
            a1 <= (16'b000001_0000000000) - (((-z) >> 5) + 16'b000000_1101100000);
          else if (((-z) > 16'b000001_0000000000) && ((-z) < 16'b000010_0110000000))
            a1 <= (16'b000001_0000000000) - (((-z) >> 3) + 16'b000000_1010000000);
          else a1 <= (16'b000001_0000000000) - (((-z) >> 2) + 16'b000000_1000000000);
        end else if (z[15] == 1'b0) begin
          if (z > 16'b000101_0000000000) a1 <= 16'b000001_0000000000;
          else if ((z > 16'b000010_0110000000) && (z < 16'b000101_0000000000))
            a1 <= (z >> 5) + 16'b000000_1101100000;
          else if ((z > 16'b000001_0000000000) && (z < 16'b000010_0110000000))
            a1 <= (z >> 3) + 16'b000000_1010000000;
          else a1 <= (z >> 2) + 16'b000000_1000000000;
        end else begin
          a1 <= a1;
        end
      end else begin
        a1 <= a1;
      end
    end
  end

  assign dout = a1;

endmodule
